code:
Call payoff = max(S - K, 0)
Put payoff  = max(K - S, 0)

Buyer's profit  = payoff - premium
Seller's profit = premium - payoff
caption: S = spot price at expiration, K = strike price. Payoff can never be negative.

steps.label: Long call
steps.sub: paid premium, profits as S rises above K

steps.label: Short call
steps.sub: collected premium, profits if S stays below K

steps.label: Long put
steps.sub: paid premium, profits as S falls below K

steps.label: Short put
steps.sub: collected premium, profits if S stays above K

eyebrow: Where the strike sits vs. the spot

steps.label: Out-of-the-money
steps.sub: zero intrinsic value, pure time value

steps.label: Premium = intrinsic + time
steps.sub: time value decays to zero by expiration

subtitle: The formula that locks call and put prices together.
